instructions_to_main_agent: 1. In `/app/src/components/arcade/ArcadeHub.tsx`: Remove the badge `...Arcade-XP separat` completely from the header banner.
2. Place the new `<Link to="/neoshop" data-testid="neoshop-button" className="...">🛒 Neoshop →</Link>` directly next to the `<CoinBalance />` component.
3. Keep the CoinBalance completely intact (`175 Coins` or real synced balance).

4. Style the button with: rounded full/pill borders, glowing cyan border (`border border-[#22E4F2]`), dark violet background (`bg-[#2B0B47]`), glowing cyan text and cart icon (`text-[#22E4F2]`), subtle neon glow shadow (`shadow-[0_0_14px_rgba(34,228,242,0.35)]`).
5. Ensure iPhone responsive layout: use `flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3` so neither CoinBalance nor Neoshop button overflows on narrow screens like iPhone SE/13 mini (375px).
6. Create `/app/src/routes/neoshop.tsx` with TanStack router integration and back button leading explicitly back to `/arcade` with `<ArrowLeft />` or `← Zurück zur Arcade`.
7. Include synced user coin balance in Neoshop, with interactive unlockable upgrades/customizations (Spot-Booster, Neon-Themes, Avatar-Frames, Arcade-Leben) using existing Coin-System.
8. Preserve all existing Arcade games (Neon Highway, Leonida Fishing), highscore tracking, and backend Arcade XP logic untouched.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Maintain authentic 80s/90s Miami Vice / Synthwave dark aesthetics with deep indigo surfaces and sharp neon cyan/pink accents.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_attributes: All new interactive elements must have clear data-testid attributes: data-testid='neoshop-button', data-testid='neoshop-back-button', data-testid='neoshop-coin-balance', data-testid='neoshop-item-card'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.framework: TanStack Router, React 19, Tailwind v4, Lucide Icons, Sonner for toasts.
